#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Offline target planner and replay evidence reconciler.

Commands (see instruction.md for the full contract):

    ipv6_replay.py plan   MANIFEST.json
    ipv6_replay.py replay MANIFEST.json RESPONSES.jsonl

Everything is synthetic: no sockets, no packets, no external services.  Each
command writes exactly one JSON object to stdout and exits 0.  Whole-file
problems (bad arguments, invalid manifest, unreadable input, size/line limit
violations) exit 2 with an empty stdout and a stderr diagnostic.  Individual
malformed replay rows are quarantined into ``diagnostics`` instead.

The words internal/external describe observable response evidence only; they
never identify a device, prove a firewall policy, or assert reachability.
Silence stays inconclusive.
"""
